note: WAEC Financial Accounting Paper 1 round 1 (Round 16e): the WASSCE syllabus with FRESH angles - mini-scenario entries (Bola sells to Ade, stamps from the float, the lorry's wear, the customer's bounced cheque), numeric mini-computations (capital N60,000, cost of sales N25,000), Nigerian regulatory bodies (ICAN, FRC, Auditor-General) and question-form stems - because the near-dup scan checks every item against the JAMB, WAEC and NECO banks INCLUDING the large JAMB Accounting banks (035-036) and the 62-item NECO Accounting bank. Topics: nature and purpose, the ledger, books of prime entry, final accounts and adjustments, cash book and bank reconciliation, trial balance and errors, regulation and ethics, partnership and company accounts.
